rounds.why: “Eine Sendung” is a TV/radio programme. A sentence is “ein Satz”.
“Ein Lied” means “a song”. A singer is “ein Sänger”.

rounds.lie: “Eigentlich mag ich Popmusik” means “Currently I like pop music”.
rounds.truth: “Eigentlich mag ich Popmusik” means “Actually, I like pop music”.
truths: “Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie” means “We celebrate Christmas with the family”.

rounds.lie: “Wir feiern Karneval im Februar” means “We avoid carnival in February”.
rounds.truth: “Wir feiern Karneval im Februar” means “We celebrate carnival in February”.

rounds.why: In German, “Silvester” is New Year's Eve (31 Dec). Christmas Eve is “Heiligabend”.

rounds.lie: “Ich bekomme ein Geschenk” means “I am becoming a present”.
rounds.why: False friend — “bekommen” means “to get/receive”. “To become” is “werden”.
rounds.truth: “Ich bekomme ein Geschenk” means “I am getting a present”.
truths: “Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Schwester” means “I get on well with my sister”.
“Ich bin Einzelkind” means “I am an only child”.
“Wir streiten uns manchmal” means “We argue sometimes”.
“Meine Eltern sind geschieden” means “My parents are divorced”.
